task.instruction: Search for a beginner-level online course about Python programming, suitable for someone who has no programming experience on Coursera.

final_answer:
I searched Coursera with the query "Python programming for beginners" and filtered the results to **Beginner** level. The top match is an excellent fit for someone with zero programming experience:

**Programming for Everybody (Getting Started with Python)** — University of Michigan
- **Instructor:** Charles Russell Severance
- **Level:** Beginner — "No prior experience required"
- **Rating:** 4.8 / 5 from 233,779 reviews (98% of learners liked it)
- **Enrollment:** 3,657,146 learners
- **Commitment:** ~2 weeks at 10 hours/week, self-paced, 7 modules
- **Cost:** Free to enroll (audit); certificate available
- **Taught in English** with 27 language options

**What you'll learn:** install Python and write your first program, understand Python basics, use variables to store/retrieve/calculate information, and use core programming tools like functions and loops. The course description explicitly states it "has no pre-requisites and avoids all but the simplest mathematics," covering Chapters 1–5 of the "Python for Everybody" textbook in Python 3. It's also the first course in the Python for Everybody Specialization if you later want to continue.

**Other beginner-level options from the same search**, in case you want to compare:
- **Python Basics** — University of Michigan (course)
- **Crash Course on Python** — Google (course)
- **Python Programming Fundamentals** — Microsoft (course)
- **Programming in Python** — Meta (course)
- **Python Programming Essentials** — Rice University (course)
- **Hello, Python!** — Google (course)

You can view the course here: https://www.coursera.org/learn/python — the "Enroll for free" button is on the page, with the next session starting Nov 1.

judge.rationale: The final page is Coursera’s “Programming for Everybody (Getting Started with Python)” showing Beginner level and “No prior experience required.”

final_page.title: Programming for Everybody (Getting Started with Python) | Coursera
